title: 第14章 自斩修为，便可一笔勾销
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
这两个月来，云鹤珏都在为阮惜惜疗伤，即便收到了她的清单折子，也没有真的会认为路仙瑶会来拿。

    如今看她这架势，东西拿不到，她是不会撤去的。

    若是天鸣剑宗真因他而覆灭，那这中州可就没有他的容身之处了……

    云鹤珏袖下的手紧攥了几分，他抬头，语气尽量放平，“我手上确实没有那么多，你今日若要，我实在拿不出来，可否用别的来抵？”

    路仙瑶从头到脚打量着他，冷笑，“你有什么东西能抵的？你自己吗？我可不要。”

    “你……”

    这时，阮惜惜飞身而来。

    “圣女，若你心中有气，冲着我一人来便罢，我……我愿随你回瑶池！”

    她声音凄楚可怜，带着令人心碎的颤抖。

    她面色苍白无血色，身形虚浮，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒般，云鹤珏急忙将她扶住，“惜惜！我不是让你好生在洞府歇息吗？你来做什么？此事与你无关，无需你来替我担责！”

    他语气焦灼又透着心疼。

    阮惜惜抬起泪眼朦胧的双眸，固执地摇头，声音虽弱却清晰，“鹤珏师兄，我明白圣女想要的，从来就不是那些身外之物……”

    她看向飞舟上红衣似火、气势凌人的路仙瑶，眼神哀婉，“她想要的……是我。”

    她又看向云鹤珏，“只要我跟她回瑶池，鹤珏师兄，天鸣剑宗便能平安无事了……”

    “胡说！”

    云鹤珏断然拒绝，将她护得更紧，“我绝不允许！”

    他抬头怒视路仙瑶，“路仙瑶，你有什么手段冲我来，休要牵连惜惜！”

    路仙瑶看着他们在自己面前上演情深似海，难分难舍的戏码，只觉得无语。

    不知道的，还以为她是什么十恶不赦，棒打鸳鸯的恶人。

    她嗤笑一声，“阮惜惜，收起你那楚楚可怜的那一套吧，我说了，我今天来只为讨回我送出去的东西，别在这儿给我添油加戏！”

    还想跟她回瑶池？

    怕是看中了瑶池浓郁的灵气，想待在瑶池修炼提升修为吧？

    这算盘珠子打得都快蹦她脸上来了！

    阮惜惜瑟缩了一下，仿佛被路仙瑶的直白吓到，泪水落得更凶：“圣女，我知道你心悦鹤珏师兄，怨我抢走了鹤珏师兄，可……可我也实在无法割舍对师兄的情意，我做不到将他拱手让人，只要你不再为难他，你要我做什么都可以！哪怕是……让我为奴为婢……”

    “惜惜，你是天上明珠，此生只会走出大帝之路，不会是谁的奴婢。”云鹤珏坚定地护着她。
content_en:
In the past two months, Yun Hejue has been healing Ruan Xixi's injuries. Even if he received her list of documents, he didn't really think that Lu Xianyao would come to get it.

    Looking at her posture now, she won't move away if she can't get the things.

    If the Tianming Sword Sect is really destroyed because of him, then there will be no place for him in Zhongzhou...

    Yun Hejue's hands under his sleeves clenched a little more tightly. He raised his head and tried to speak as calmly as possible, "I really don't have that much on hand. If you want it today, I really can't afford it. Can you use something else to offset it?"

    Lu Xianyao looked at him from head to toe and sneered, "What can you offer? Yourself? I don't want it."

    "You..."

    At this time, Ruan Xixi flew over.

    "Saint Girl, if you are angry in your heart, just come against me alone, I...I am willing to go back to Yaochi with you!"

    Her voice was pitiful and pitiful, with a heartbreaking tremor.

    Her face was pale and bloodless, and her body was buoyant, as if a gust of wind could blow her down. Yun Hejue hurriedly supported her, "Xixi! Didn't I let you rest in the cave for a long time? What are you doing here? This matter has nothing to do with you, and you don't need to take responsibility for me!"

    His tone was anxious and distressed.

    Ruan Xixi raised her tear-filled eyes and shook her head stubbornly. Her voice was weak but clear, "Senior Brother Hejue, I understand that what the Saint wants is never the things outside her body..."

    She looked at Lu Xianyao, who was in red clothes and had an imposing manner on the flying boat, with a sad look in her eyes, "What she wants...is me."

    She looked at Yun Hejue again, "As long as I return to Yaochi with her, Senior Brother Hejue and the Tianming Sword Sect will be safe..."

    "Nonsense!"

    Yun Hejue flatly refused and protected her even tighter, "I will never allow it!"

    He raised his head and glared at Lu Xianyao, "Lu Xianyao, if you have any means to attack me, don't implicate Xixi!"

    Lu Xianyao felt speechless as she watched them play out the drama of deep love and inseparability in front of her.

    Those who didn’t know better thought she was some kind of evil person who would beat up mandarin ducks.

    She sneered, "Ruan Xixi, put away your pitiful ways. I told you, I'm here today just to get back what I gave away. Don't add fuel to my drama here!"

    Still want to go back to Yaochi with her?

    Maybe you have taken a fancy to the rich spiritual energy of Yaochi and want to stay in Yaochi to practice and improve your cultivation level?

    The abacus beads were so hard that they almost jumped onto her face!

    Ruan Xixi shrank, as if she was frightened by Lu Xianyao's frankness, and her tears fell even more fiercely: "Holy girl, I know that you are fond of Senior Brother Hejue, and you blame me for taking away Senior Brother Hejue, but...but I really can't let go of my feelings for Senior Brother. I can't give him up. As long as you don't embarrass him anymore, you can do whatever you want from me! Even...make me your slave..."

    "Xixi, you are a pearl in the sky. You will only walk the path of the great emperor in this life, and you will not be anyone's slave." Yun Hejue firmly protected her.
title_en: Chapter 14: If you cut off your own cultivation, you can cancel it with one stroke
